description: This file declares the EnoughData class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for handling 'enough data' events in a media player context. It includes references to GStreamer app source and a custom player context.

classes.name: EnoughData
classes.description: A class representing a task to handle sufficient data availability in a media player, derived from IPlayerTask.

methods.name: EnoughData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with a player context and GStreamer app source.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task logic when enough data is available.
